steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The source of all evil... is that...
The two look up—and up—at an indescribably towering building...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Yes. Unlike the Bureau in reality, the Bureau here has a different name here...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Such is the rule of this world. I cannot speak its full name.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I can't accept this both mentally and physically! What were those ducks thinking when they built this world?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Look at this Bureau building—who came up with this awful design?! I’ve seen Corruptors that look better than this!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I think it's not too bad, at least it's better looking than most of the Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How is this not too bad?! Look at those gross spinning eyeballs! Calling them frog eyes would be a compliment!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Watch out, those are laser guns.
Hecate shoves Hella down as a laser beam sweeps over her head.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tsk, what a pain... Even here, the Bureau's defense is just as annoying as ever.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But... this all ends now! This world doesn't need any more weird Sinners, and it definitely doesn't need such a hideous Bureau!
